classification.difficultyReason: Plot three supplied points, form the triangle, identify its horizontal base and perpendicular height, then apply the taught half-base-times-height formula.

content.prompt: Points $A$, $B$ and $C$ have coordinates $(1,0)$, $(3,2)$ and $(5,0)$, respectively. Plot the points and join them with straight lines. What is the area of the triangle $ABC$?

answer.worked:
The plotted triangle has base $AC=4$ units and perpendicular height $2$ units.

$\begin{align*}\operatorname{Area}(\triangle ABC)&=\frac12\times4\times2\\\operatorname{Area}(\triangle ABC)&=4\text{ square units}\end{align*}$

spec.description: Complete plotted triangle with all three vertices labelled.
